3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:16198646-f722.description: Launch and Grow Your Own ABA Practice — with Zero Upfront Costs Join 3Y Health and earn $100,000 - $320,000/year while making your own schedule. Tired of rigid clinical environments and professional burnout? Looking to build a practice and don’t know where to start? At 3Y Health, we believe BCBAs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where you can launch and grow your own ABA practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://3yhealth.com/specialties/autism-therapy-aba What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you, your RBTs, and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re in-network with 100+ payers at high market rates, giving you broad access to patients. - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own ABA company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you and your RBTs if you’d like. Your Role: - Own and operate your practice – Set your hours, select clients, and define how you deliver care. - Hire and lead your RBTs – Build a team that aligns with your vision. - Deliver exceptional ABA therapy – You’re the expert. We give you the platform to thrive. Why BCBAs Love 3Y Health: - 100% autonomy with zero admin headaches - Real earning potential with no financial risk - Flexible work-from-anywhere model - Make a bigger impact without burning out

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:455.title: Seasonal Retail Gearhead / Sales Associate - Part Time (Backcountry)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:455.description: At Backcountry, our mission is to connect people to their passions. Our five online stores—Backcountry, Level Nine Sports, Competitive Cyclist, MotoSport, and SteepandCheap—aim to supply our customers with the gear, knowledge, and inspiration necessary to get out there and chase down life’s greatest moments. We do this by providing the biggest and best assortment of premium outdoor products, a superior shopping experience, personalized Gearhead expertise, lightning-fast and accurate fulfillment, and inspirational, informative, and community-centered content. The ideal candidate should have a passion for outdoor activities and possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills. We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Seasonal Retail Gearhead (Sales Associate) to join our retail team for the holiday season (expected employment from November through February). The successful candidate will be responsible for providing exceptional customer service, generating sales, and helping customers find the right outdoor gear and apparel for their needs. Holiday Availability: Must be able to work two of the three major winter holidays (Thanksgiving/Black Friday, Christmas, New Year’s Eve/New Year’s Day).

Must have a flexible schedule, including availability for nights, weekends, and holidays

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2c63f32f-a595-.title: Assistente Administrativo de PMO
jobgether-jobgether:lever:2c63f32f-a595-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Assistente Administrativo de PMO based in Brazil. This role offers the opportunity to support a Project Management Office in its day-to-day administrative and operational activities. You will help keep project routines organized, ensuring controls, indicators, documentation, and internal processes remain up to date. The position involves collaborating with different teams and supporting meetings, training sessions, events, and administrative requests. You will also contribute to access management and the smooth execution of PMO initiatives. Strong organization, communication, prioritization, and a proactive approach will be essential to succeeding in the role. You will work in a collaborative environment where attention to detail and reliability directly contribute to operational efficiency. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their experience in project management and corporate operations.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:c6833bd7-33d2-.title: Engineering Manager - Product
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c6833bd7-33d2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager - Product based in Canada. This is an opportunity to lead a high-impact product engineering team within an early-stage, fully distributed software environment. You’ll guide a compact group of engineers responsible for turning customer needs into valuable, reliable product capabilities. The team works across cloud spend management, data pipelines, visualization, and intuitive product experiences. You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to ensure engineering priorities remain aligned with customer needs and business goals. The role combines people leadership, delivery ownership, technical judgment, and organizational development. You’ll have meaningful influence over engineering standards, team growth, hiring, and how products move from idea to launch. It’s an ideal opportunity for an experienced engineering leader who thrives on autonomy, collaboration, and building high-performing teams in a fast-moving environment. Lead, coach, develop, and grow a compact product engineering team while maintaining a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture. Establish clear priorities, maintain alignment across the team, remove delivery blockers, and ensure consistent progress toward product goals. Partner closely with Product and Design to translate customer needs and business priorities into focused engineering initiatives. Guide the team in balancing delivery speed, technical quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability when making engineering tradeoffs. Enable engineers to take ownership of features from initial concepts and technical planning through implementation, testing, and launch. Establish and maintain practical standards for software design, testing, documentation, technical decisions, and engineering processes. Support recruiting, onboarding, mentoring, and development of new engineering talent as the organization grows. Strengthen collaboration across engineering, product, design, and leadership to ensure decisions are clear and execution remains coordinated. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and strong communication. Help the team deliver dependable and performant product capabilities across spend management, data, visualization, and application infrastructure. Requirements Proven experience managing and developing software engineering teams, ideally within a product-focused technology environment. Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams, develop engineers, and create an environment where people can do their best work. Strong product mindset with the ability to understand customer needs, business priorities, and technical considerations when setting engineering direction. Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to maintain clarity across multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. Strong judgment when balancing velocity, engineering quality, technical debt, and customer impact. Experience enabling engineers to own features and projects throughout the complete development lifecycle. Comfortable operating in an early-stage or rapidly evolving environment where processes and priorities continue to develop. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Design, and senior leadership. Experience with or familiarity with modern software development environments such as TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Terraform, GCP, dbt, and Dagster is beneficial but not mandatory. Experience leading engineers within a young startup is a strong plus. Exposure to FinOps, cloud infrastructure, cloud cost optimization, or data platforms is advantageous. Hands-on experience with a comparable modern technology stack is also a plus. Benefits Base salary of up to $300,000 CAD , plus additional compensation op

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:a6a442.title: Analytics Engineer
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:a6a442.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. Profound is on a mission to help companies understand and control their AI presence. As an Analytics Engineer, you will build and own the product analytics foundation at Profound. You will define success metrics, map the user journey, and uncover insights that shape how we build and improve the product. Your work will help the entire company understand what drives engagement, where users drop off, and how we can make the platform more valuable to our customers. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Build and maintain dashboards to track product usage, funnels, retention, activation, user journey paths, and feature adoption - Define and maintain core product metrics and ensure they are modeled cleanly and reliably - Analyze user journeys to identify friction, improve activation, and drive growth - Respond to one-off customer analysis requests by delivering custom solutions and insights - Conduct customer-level and segment analyses to support sales, marketing, and customer success - Partner with engineers to instrument events, maintain data ingestion pipelines, and uphold high data quality WHO YOU ARE - Fluency in SQL and experience with Python - Experience working on product analytics including funnels, retention, user journeys, and activation - Strong data modeling skills and a clean approach to defining metrics - Experience at a B2B SaaS or product-focused company - 3 or more years of experience in analytics, data, or product roles focused on user behavior and product usage - Strong product sense and ability to turn data into clear insights for product and go-to-market teams - Strong sense of ownership and accountability for data quality and reliability - Motivated by ownership of the entire product analytics function at an early stage company - Interested in shaping how usage is measured and how product decisions are made - Excited by close collaboration with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with trust and autonomy - Drawn to competitive compensation and meaningful equity LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. We are happy to support visa sponsorship for qualified international candidates. For this role, the expected base salary range is $180,000 to $260,000. Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. #LI-PRO Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.
